name: crs2_Results
description: The data returned by the service call.

AFRRows.description: Displays the number of Administrative Formal cases within the search results.

CAARows.description: The number of facilities or cases within the result set that have Clean Air Act (CAA) permits.

CERCLARows.description: The number of cases within the results set that relate to the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liability Act (CERCLA).

CWARows.description: The number of facilities or cases within the results set that have Clean Water Act (CWA) permits.

Cases.description: A summary of the violation(s), environmental problem(s), and a description of the cause of action.

CriminalRows.description: Displays the number of criminal enforcement cases within the search results.

EPCRARows.description: The number of cases within the results set that relate to the Emergency Planning and Community Right to Know Act (EPCRA).

FIFRARows.description: The number of cases within the result set that relate to the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA).

FedPenRows.description: Displays the number of cases with federal penalty assessed greater than $0.

FederalRows.description: The number of facilities or cases within the result set that have a relationship to a Federal facility.

JDCRows.description: Displays the number of Judicial cases within the search results.

Message.description: Field to record messages (typically performance-related) about packet processing

PageNo.description: The number of pages of results returned

QueryID.description: Sequential number assigned to entire search result

RCRARows.description: The number of facilities or cases within the results set that have Resource Conservation and Recovery Action (RCRA) permits.

SDWARows.description: The number of facilities or cases within the results set that have Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA) permits.

SEPRows.description: Displays the number of cases with SEP amount greater than $0.

TSCARows.description: The number of cases within the result set that relate to the Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA).
